_comment: Registry of the disease-specific reference cohorts. Adding a cancer = adding an entry here + building its two reference tables (node scripts/build_expression.mjs <key> and node scripts/build_depmap.mjs <key>). The genetic/safety/druggability/clinical/literature/annotation/tissue/patents axes work for ANY disease with no entry; only expression + dependency are cohort-specific. resolveCohort() matches by MONDO id or by any alias appearing in the Open Targets disease name.
_verify: The xena_primary_site / xena_tcga_disease / depmap_lineage strings below are best-effort for the current TCGA+GTEx (UCSC Xena Toil) and DepMap releases. If a value is off for your release, the build script FAILS LOUDLY ('No tumor/normal samples matched' or 'No cell lines matched lineage') — fix that one field against the phenotype _primary_site / detailed_category columns (Xena) or the OncotreeLineage column (DepMap Model.csv) and rerun. depmap_lineage is matched as a case-insensitive substring, so short stable tokens (e.g. 'Ovary', 'Stomach') are used deliberately.
_note_mutation: cbioportal_study is informational. The mutation axis resolves its own cohort via evidenceProviders.CBIO_STUDY_MAP (currently pancreatic + glioblastoma). A new cancer gets expression + dependency from this registry immediately; mutation stays empty until its study is added to CBIO_STUDY_MAP too.
